Has catch-and-release fishing ponds but RV sites are not confirmed pond-front. (Coords are park-level - refine to the RV loop if needed.) --Claude
summary: Added fees $50 (weekly $300, monthly $700), 29 full-hookup sites with 50-ft pull-thrus, year-round, wifi, booking on CampLife with a 2-night minimum every date tried; confirmed water/sewer, pull-through, reservable. Note: dropped the site-count/hookup/reservations restatements and the 'full/partial hookups' (the park says all 29 are full).

Online booking looks empty: CampLife's session for park 6385653 lists no site types and no sites, every one-night request answers 'There is a 2 night minimum stay for this period', and two-night searches in Oct/Nov 2026 and Jun 2027 return 'No sites available' - the 2-night minimum is real but the park may be taking RV bookings only by phone (304-737-1236).
